fields.scope: OrleansExpressionHelper compiled grain-identity and shard-routing delegate builders (ArgentSea.Orleans/src/GrainPersistance/OrleansExpressionHelper.cs)
fields.statement: OrleansExpressionHelper must compile and cache each grain state type's key-marshalling and shard-routing delegates once per model type (and validation mode where applicable), validating [MapShardKey] and [MapTo*] property bindings and SpanParser key-type compatibility at expression-compilation time rather than per grain activation or persistence call.
